tools.name: query
tools.description: Search through conversation transcripts using semantic + keyword search. Translate 'query' to English — summaries and facts are indexed in English. Use 'keywords' for names, brands, or terms that must match exactly as spoken.

query.description: Search query in English (used for semantic search over summaries and facts)

keywords.description: Optional exact-match terms in the original language of the conversation (used for BM25 keyword search over utterances). Use for names, brands, or specific terms.

folder_path.description: Optional folder path from root, e.g. ["Clients - Active", "Acme Corp"]. Searches the entire subtree.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Retrieve full conversation transcripts without semantic search. Use when you need the complete text of a specific dialog or the most recent dialogs in a folder.

doc_id.description: Specific document ID. If provided, all other params are ignored.

folder_path.description: Folder path from root, e.g. ["Acme Corp"]. Returns transcripts from the entire subtree.

limit.description: Max number of most recent transcripts to return (default: 1)

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List all folders in the knowledge base as a tree with dialog counts and last dialog dates. Call this first to discover the folder hierarchy before querying. If the response contains a 'suggestion' field, present it to the user.

tools.name: import_all_transcripts
tools.description: Trigger a full import of all transcripts from connected providers. Only transcripts not yet in the database will be imported. Use for initial onboarding or after a long offline period. Import in small batches (default 10), then review and assign transcripts before importing the next batch.

limit.description: Max number of transcripts to import in this batch (default: 10)

since.description: ISO date to import from (e.g. 2025-01-01). If not set, imports all transcripts.

tools.name: move_transcript
tools.description: Move a transcript to a different folder. Updates Google Drive, resets the record for reindexing, and removes old vectors from the search index.

folder_path.description: Target folder path from root, e.g. ["Clients - Active", "Acme Corp"]

tools.name: move_folder
tools.description: Move a folder to a different location in the hierarchy. Updates Google Drive and the folder index. Documents inside are not reindexed — their parent_id remains stable.

folder_path.description: Path of the folder to move, e.g. ["Clients - Active", "Acme Corp"]

new_parent_path.description: Path of the new parent folder, e.g. ["Clients - Past"]. Empty or omitted = move to root.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive and register it in the knowledge base.

parent_path.description: Parent folder path from root, e.g. ["Clients - Active"]. Empty or omitted = create at root level.

tools.name: rename_folder
tools.description: Rename a folder in the knowledge base. Updates Google Drive and the folder index. Documents inside are not reindexed.

folder_path.description: Path of the folder to rename, e.g. ["Clients - Active", "Old Name"]

tools.name: sync_changes
tools.description: Sync recent changes from Google Drive. Use doc_id only when a forced resync of a specific document is needed.

doc_id.description: Resync a specific document by ID

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: Show the current sync status: how many transcripts are in each stage (queued, downloading, imported, syncing, synced, error) and how many are unassigned. Use to diagnose stuck imports or check overall system health.

tools.name: add_fact
tools.description: Manually add a fact to a specific transcript. Use when semantic search missed an important detail — pins the document to relevant future queries.

doc_id.description: Document ID to attach the fact to

text.description: The fact to remember, in English

tools.name: list_recent_transcripts
tools.description: List transcripts sorted by date descending. Use to find recent recordings without knowing the folder. Supports optional folder_path and date range filters, and pagination.

folder_path.description: Filter by folder path, e.g. ["Clients - Active", "Acme Corp"] (optional)

tools.name: rename_transcript
tools.description: Rename a transcript: updates the file name in Google Drive and the title visible in list_recent_transcripts.
